general: Stay in a cool place during the hottest part of the day.
Drink water regularly, even if you are not thirsty — unless your care team told you to limit fluids.
Check on neighbors, friends and family, especially people who live alone.
urgent: Go to a cool place now.
If you feel confused, very weak, or faint, call 911.
Call your care team if you feel unwell.
disclaimer: This is a hackathon demo, not medical advice. Do not stop or change any medicine without talking to your care team.
